rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: Male half-human half-snake Anadolu being, emerging from the underground.

visual_requirements.description: Human upper body and single snake body below waist; two arms, no legs, opaque clothing.
Emerging in underground world of clever snakes.

aura: Keagungan melalui anatomi setengah manusia setengah ular dari bawah tanah (rbuk-c01, rbuk-c04, rbuk-c08), tanpa kuasa visual rekaan.
artistic_choices: Palet walnut dan emas antik, sinematik low-key; pilihan editorial bukan klaim baru.
Opaque ancient robe, hair and cavern lighting are editorial choices. No healing effect portrayed because remedy ability does not specify a visible mechanism.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of ERBÜKE (Ərbükə), the half-human half-snake being of Anadolu folk tales.
ANATOMY: exactly ONE human male head, TWO human arms, human upper torso, exactly ONE continuous thick snake body below the waist, no human legs and no feet [rbuk-c01,c08,c11]; upper body fully clothed in opaque rough ancient earth-brown robe, no crown, no weapons, no invented horns.
MOMENT: uncoiling upward from the underground toward the viewer, one arm braced against rough stone, other open hand extending forward, focused grave gaze; snake coils sweep across foreground and visibly connect at waist.
POWER: no visual magical effects; no invented healing beams. Awe through documented hybrid anatomy and active movement only.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close view, body and head fill square; no invented enormous scale comparison.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one distant warm opening lights face and wet scales, deep underground shadows, natural stone dust.
SURFACE: wet dark olive snake scales, rough opaque linen wool robe, damp rock.
SETTING: underground world of clever snakes [rbuk-c04].
MOOD: solemn and awe-inspiring intelligent being, healer tradition respected, not villainous or attacking.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra head, snake tail, limbs or fingers; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
